items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: And Jack Henderson was the other alto man.

ctx.x: Well, Root Bigadack was the piano player. Les Cooper was the saxophone, first saxophone. Frank Llewellyn was the trombone player. And Fred Follensby was the tenor man. And Jack Henderson was the other alto man. And -- I'll tell you who came around there, and wanted to sit in, was Johnny -- he was quite a popular singer a few years back and he disappeared -- Johnny -- he's a guitar player. Now his last name's gone. Anyway --
